Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 rel_alt number;
begin


 rel_alt := show_alert('release_alert');

 if rel_alt=ALERT_BUTTON1 then /* if user clicks YES then release the interdiction */
 begin
 
 
 update donor_interdictions set release_date=to_date(:exist_inter_blk.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'),
 release_user=:banner.user_id
 where donor_id=:ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_code=:exist_inter_blk.inter_code
 and nvl(originated_from,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.originated_from,'LPL')
 and nvl(group_mode,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.group_mode,'LPL')
 and nvl(group_id,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.group_id,'LPL')
 and nvl(reason_code,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.reason_code,'LPL')
 and trunc(eff_date) = trunc(to_date(:exist_inter_blk.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'))
 and trunc(term_date)= trunc(to_date(:exist_inter_blk.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'));

 update inter_transactions set release_date=to_date(:exist_inter_blk.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'),
 release_user=:banner.user_id
 where donor_id=:ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_code=:exist_inter_blk.inter_code
 and nvl(originated_from,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.originated_from,'LPL')
 and nvl(group_mode,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.group_mode,'LPL')
 and nvl(group_id,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.group_id,'LPL')
 and nvl(reason_code,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.reason_code,'LPL')
 and trunc(eff_date) = trunc(to_date(:exist_inter_blk.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'))
 and trunc(term_date)= trunc(to_date(:exist_inter_blk.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'));

 end;
 end if;
 :system.message_level :=25;
 commit_form;
 :system.message_level :=10;
 
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 c_perm_flg varchar2(1) := NULL;
 reason_reqd varchar2(1) :='0';

begin

/* Added the code to solve the problem of Field must be entered */
 
 if :exist_inter_blk.reason_reqd='Y' then
 :exist_inter_blk.reason_reqd:='N';
 reason_reqd:='1';
 end if;
 :ctrl_blk.dummy_currec := :system.cursor_record;
 go_block('rem_intr_blk');
 show_window('windrem');
 :rem_intr_blk.inter_code := :exist_inter_blk.inter_code;
 :rem_intr_blk.inter_desc := :exist_inter_blk.inter_desc;
 :rem_intr_blk.term := NULL; 

 -- Set the Term field

 begin
 select 'Y'
 into c_perm_flg
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code=:exist_inter_blk.inter_code
 and deferral_flag ='Y'
 and period_type='P';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;
 
 if c_perm_flg ='Y' then
 :rem_intr_blk.term := 'Indefinite';
 end if;

 go_item('rem_intr_blk.reason_cd');
 
 /* Added to solve the problem of Field Must be entered */
 :global.close:='NO'; /* Not to validate the Close button is pressed */
 if reason_reqd='1' then
 :exist_inter_blk.reason_reqd :='Y';
 end if;

 end;

 and nvl(originated_from,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.originated_from,'LPL')
 and nvl(group_mode,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.group_mode,'LPL')

 and trunc(eff_date) = trunc(:exist_inter_blk.eff_date)

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 c_usps_id donor_addresses.usps_id%type;
 c_dob donors.date_of_birth%type;
 c_ssn varchar2(10);
 c_abo varchar2(5);
 chk_all number :=0;
 other_inter1 number :=0;
 other_inter2 number :=0;
 term_count number :=0;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_time1 date;
 v_local_date date;
 v_local_date1 date;
 v_str varchar2(2000) ;
 v_str1 varchar2(2000);
 

BEGIN

 :ctrl_blk.donor_id := :find_donors.donor_id;
v_str:='010';
 /* populate name,date of birth , ssn ,sex*/

 select initcap(ltrim(rtrim(last_name)))||', '||initcap(ltrim(rtrim(first_name)))||' '||
 initcap(ltrim(rtrim(middle_name))),
 date_of_birth,
 decode(gender,'F','Female','M','Male'),
 nvl(blood_type,'NONE')
 into :ctrl_blk.name,
 c_dob,
 :ctrl_blk.sex,
 c_abo
 from donors
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id;
 c_ssn := lpad(c_ssn,9,0); ---- Added by MG 8/15/99 for SSN formatting
 v_str:='011';
 
 v_str:='012';
 :ctrl_blk.date_of_birth := to_char(c_dob,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 v_str:='013';
 synchronize;

 /* populate street , suite/apartment */

 Begin
 select street_name, suite_apt,usps_id
 into :ctrl_blk.street_name,
 :ctrl_blk.suite_apt,
 c_usps_id 
 from donor_addresses
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id;
 v_str:='014';
 Exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11212'); /* No address available */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 /* populate city,state,zip */

 synchronize;
 Declare
 v_flag varchar2(1);
 Begin
 SELECT NVL (intl_addr_flag, 'N')
 INTO v_flag
 FROM donor_addresses da
 WHERE donor_id =:ctrl_blk.donor_id;

 If v_flag='N' then
 select zip,
 city,
 state
 into :ctrl_blk.zip,
 :ctrl_blk.city,
 :ctrl_blk.state
 from valid_city_state
 where usps_id = c_usps_id;
 v_str:='015';
 Elsif v_flag='Y' then
 
 SELECT d.last_name, d.first_name, lpad(to_char(d.ssn),9,0), -- decode(ssnMode, 4, substr(d.ssn, 
 TO_CHAR (d.date_of_birth, 'MM-DD-YYYY'), d.gender,
 da.intl_address_1||decode(da.intl_address_2,nvl(da.intl_address_2,0),',',null)||' '||
 da.intl_address_2||decode(da.intl_address_3,nvl(da.intl_address_3,0),',',null)||' '||
 da.intl_address_3||decode(da.intl_address_4,nvl(da.intl_address_4,0),',',null)||' '||
 da.intl_address_4||decode(country_name,nvl(country_name,0),',',null)||' '||
 COUNTRY_NAME||decode(intl_postal_code,nvl(intl_postal_code,0),',',null)||' '||INTL_POSTAL_CODE as international_addresses
 INTO :GLOBAL.last_name, :GLOBAL.first_name, :GLOBAL.ssn,:GLOBAL.dob, :GLOBAL.s_sex,:global.s_address1
 FROM donors d, donor_addresses da 
 WHERE d.donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 AND d.donor_id = da.donor_id; 
 --:ctrl_blk_1.dob := to_date(:GLOBAL.dob,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 --:ctrl_blk_1.s_sex := :GLOBAL.s_sex;
 -- :ctrl_blk_1.first_name := :GLOBAL.first_name; 
 :ctrl_blk.intl_addr:=:global.s_address1;
 
 End if;
 -- End IF;
 Exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('18032'); /* City address is not maintained */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 End; 

 /* populate blood type */

 Begin
 select substr(description,1,20) into :ctrl_blk.blood_type from valid_master_codes where
 code_type='ABO' and code=c_abo;
 v_str:='016';
 Exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11040'); /* Invalid Blood Type */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 End; 
 
 /* other interdictions which are not part of the classes of the current user */

 synchronize;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then 
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 
 else
 v_local_date := trunc(sysdate);
 
 end if;
 Begin

 select nvl(count(*),0) into chk_all from valid_acl_codes -- It was "select 1 into" 
 where access_code_type='INTER'
 -- and access_code_value ='ALL' commented by Edwin on 06-08-01 becuase it is wrong (access code value will never have 'ALL', it access class)
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1)
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1));
 v_str:='017';
 Exception
 when no_data_found then
 chk_all :=0;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 End;

 IF chk_all > 0 then --- it was "if chk_all =0 "
 Begin
 select count(*) into :ctrl_blk.other_inter
 from donor_interdictions where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_code in (select c.inter_code
 from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b,
 valid_user_access_classes a
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 and v_local_date between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,v_local_date+1)
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and v_local_date between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,v_local_date+1)
 and b.access_code_type='INTER'
 and b.access_class='ALL' --- Modified by edwin because there is no ALL for this field "b.access_code_value='ALL'"
 and c.inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD')
 and c.view_level>=a.inter_level
 and v_local_date between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date,v_local_date+1))
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD');
-- and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(eff_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),sysdate+1)
v_str:='018';
 Exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 End;
 
 ELSE

 /* Calculate the no of interdictions which doesn't belong to the
 users access classes */
 Begin
 select count(*)
 into other_inter1
 from donor_interdictions 
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_code not in (select access_code_value 
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER' 
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class
 from valid_user_access_classes 
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1))
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1))
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD');
 -- and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(eff_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),sysdate+1); 
v_str:='019';
 Exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 End;

 /*Calculate the no of interdictions placed on the donor but he user
 doesn't have access to remove */
 Begin
 select count(*)
 into other_inter2
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_code in (select c.inter_code
 from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b,
 valid_user_access_classes a
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 and v_local_date between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,v_local_date+1)
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and v_local_date between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,v_local_date+1)
 and b.access_code_type='INTER'
 and b.access_code_value=c.inter_code
 and c.view_level>=a.inter_level
 and v_local_date between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date,v_local_date+1))
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD')
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1);
v_str:='020';
 Exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 End;

 :ctrl_blk.other_inter := other_inter1+other_inter2;
v_str:='021';
 END IF; 

 synchronize;

 select count(*)
 into term_count
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_code in (select access_code_value 
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER' 
 and access_class in (select access_class
 from valid_user_access_classes 
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1))
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1))
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD');
-- and trunc(term_date) < trunc(sysdate);

v_str:='022';
/* poplate existing interdictions and go to new_inter_blk to 
 enable the user to enter new interdictions */

 synchronize;
 go_block('exist_inter_blk');
 

 
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 note number;
 rem_alt number;
 p_status varchar2(250);
 c_insert_date date;
 szChapter Varchar2(5);
 v_local_date date;
 v_local_time date;
 
begin

 /* check if reason_cd is entered . If not give the
 error message */
 if :exist_inter_blk.reason_reqd='Y' then
 if :rem_intr_blk.reason_cd is null then
 show_error('0080'); /* Field must be entered */
 end if;
 end if;





 rem_alt := show_alert('remove_alert');

 if rem_alt=ALERT_BUTTON1 then /* if user clicks YES then remove the interdiction */
 begin
 
 c_insert_date:= trunc(:exist_inter_blk.insert_date);
 -- message('insert date ' || to_char(c_insert_date,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi.ss'));pause; 
 
 
 If IS_MULTI_CHAPTER then
 szChapter:='ALL';
 Else
 szChapter:=:global.chapter_id;
 End If;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 DON_INTER.inter_upgrade_remove(:ctrl_blk.donor_id,
 szChapter,--:global.chapter_id,
 :exist_inter_blk.unit_id,
 NULL,
 :rem_intr_blk.inter_code,
 :exist_inter_blk.originated_from,
 :exist_inter_blk.reason_code,
 :banner.user_id,
 :exist_inter_blk.group_mode,
 :exist_inter_blk.group_id,
 :banner.prog_name,
 NULL,
 c_insert_date,
 :rem_intr_blk.term_date,
 :rem_intr_blk.reason_cd,
 :rem_intr_blk.comment,
 p_status);
 -- message('insert date'||' '||to_char(c_insert_date,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi'));pause;

 /* Get the existing interdictions which the user can remove. if the
 user has ALL access class */

 select nvl(count(*),0)

 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
-- and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)

 and inter_code in( select c.inter_code
 from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b,

-- and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(eff_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),sysdate+1)
 and inter_type in (select code

 where code_type='INTUD');

--message('chk inter count'||' '||chk_inter_count);pause;

 /* if is_timezone_enabled then

DECLARE
 l_chp_id VARCHAR2(4);
 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
